summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Nicklaus on Koepka
items.text: Jack Nicklaus has acknowledged Brooks Koepka's success by noting he has led in everything there is to win in golf.

items.headline: Koepka's Feud with DeChambeau
items.text: Brooks Koepka mocked Bryson DeChambeau for his comments about Rory McIlroy at the 2025 Masters, saying DeChambeau “lives in his own world” and few want to talk to him.
